0022600017.text: The Brooklyn Nets (0-3, 0-2 at home) host the Detroit Pistons (3-0, on a three-game winning streak and first in the East) as the Nets look to snap a three-game losing streak, and Brooklyn sits 14th in the East and 5th in the Atlantic, 2.5 games back. Tyler Bilodeau is out for Brooklyn with a shoulder sprain, and Jalen Duren is out for Detroit with a hamstring strain; the teams have no games yet this season, and the Nets lost 1-3 to the Pistons in the 2025-26 season. The most recent meeting was on March 10, 2026, in Brooklyn, when the Nets lost 138-100.
